materialization_conventions.authority_limit: These are concrete authored representations for review, not newly accepted scientific policy. No SUT body/output was consulted.
materialization_conventions.trace_identity: External Trace.event_id is the supplied event_id, microstep0. Internal transition ID is cause_event_id + /transition/ + Txx; positive microsteps increase along a causal chain. Boundary IDs are batch_id + /boundary/ + kind + / + identity + / + tick. Closure ID is batch_id + /continuation-check. Implicit time/continuation roots name the sealed batch and initial snapshot digest in causal_roots.
materialization_conventions.trace_decisions: External receipt/denial/intent and internal state-transition outcomes are distinct traces. Internal candidate transitions are OBSERVE except revoking T06/T09/T14, which are REVOKE. Rejected identity receipt is REJECT; its critical closure is separately REVOKE.
materialization_conventions.state_change_linearization: External guarded request may ACCEPT eligibility; a child transition Trace records actual supervisor before/after state. No state transition creates a Permission. Critical external fact latches/revokes first; child traces record T06/T09 or T14.
materialization_conventions.denial_precedence: Only first denying operation category is returned, with all causes in that category. Critical closure may add NO_VALID_POLICY. Knowledge is retained in fault/unknown fields, never appended OK on denial. Historical salient row lists are separately preserved.
materialization_conventions.batch_root: A causal root outside the Trace array binds the exact supplied SealedBatch and initial Snapshot. It is not a generated endpoint event.
materialization_conventions.scope_labels: HOST_LOGICAL for host decisions. SUPPLIED_OBSERVATION for journal-only endpoint/barrier installation facts. Labels/text are authored presentation conventions awaiting independent review.
materialization_conventions.identity_effects: Exact input content digests and explicit operation keys are authored review data. Event content digest binds the complete canonical event envelope. A future comparator must review this preimage convention rather than silently adopting implementation hashes.
materialization_conventions.nondecisional_boundaries: An irrelevant requested-policy evidence expiry is observed without latching a fault in still-admissible nominal authority. Active packet/rest/permission boundaries retain their actual authority effects.
materialization_conventions.full_status_meaning: COMPLETE_LITERAL_CANDIDATE means every Trace field and requested semantic effect is explicitly authored. It does not mean unique derivation, independent acceptance, executable wiring or a passing implementation.
